user.title: San Jose Water
user.description: Sign in with your SJWaterHUB login (sjwaterhub.com). Needs a smart meter: the integration imports its hourly readings and your bills for the Energy dashboard (water and cost), compares billing periods with last year and passes on San Jose Water's leak alerts. Unofficial; not affiliated with San Jose Water.

account.title: Choose an account
account.description: This login has more than one San Jose Water account. Pick one; add the integration again for the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: SJWaterHUB no longer accepts the saved password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: Username or password not accepted by SJWaterHUB.
error.verification_required: SJWaterHUB wants an extra step first (verification code, email confirmation or password change). Sign in once at sjwaterhub.com in a browser, then try again.
error.account_locked: SJWaterHUB has temporarily blocked sign-in for this login (too many attempts or a disabled profile). Wait 15 minutes or check at sjwaterhub.com.
error.no_accounts: SJWaterHUB signed you in but says this login has no qualifying accounts. Check that your account shows at sjwaterhub.com.
error.no_usage_data: No hourly smart-meter readings were found for this account. They appear once San Jose Water has installed a smart meter at the address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SJWaterHUB, or it answered unexpectedly. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: Hours between checks (2-24). SJWaterHUB publishes hourly readings a few hours late and bills every two months.
data_description.stale_hours: Data delayed turns on when SJWaterHUB has not published new readings for this long.
